title: Artists from Different Generations Interpret Chico Buarque Classics
subtitle: Project brings together different generations and genres of Brazilian music to reinterpret works.
excerpt: Artists from different generations and genres gather in a project to reinterpret Chico Buarque classics with new beats.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Artists from different generations and genres of Brazilian music have come together in a project to reinterpret and infuse new beats into Chico Buarque classics.

The initiative highlights the versatility of the composer's work by bringing together different musical styles and artists from various backgrounds around his traditional repertoire.

The listening session for Chico 2.0 took place this Thursday (20), in Barra da Tijuca, marking the presentation of the project that blends modern sounds with the classics known to the public.

With information from Agência Brasil.
